scope: Exploratory DNE-grouped CV, TULIP LOSO, and DNE-only-trained external TULIP evaluation; no combined training.

selectors.corr_rf_importance: training-fold constant removal + Spearman |rho|>=0.95 filter, then RF impurity importance top-k
selectors.l1_logistic: training-fold constant removal + StandardScaler + L1 logistic ranking top-k (RF baseline only)

models.svm_rbf: Pipeline(StandardScaler, SVC(rbf, probability=True)); GridSearchCV({'svc__C': [0.5, 1.0, 10.0], 'svc__gamma': ['scale', 0.01]}) in inner StratifiedGroupKFold
models.logreg_l2: Pipeline(StandardScaler, LogisticRegression(l2)); GridSearchCV({'logisticregression__C': [0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0]}) in inner StratifiedGroupKFold

inner_cv: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=min(3, rarest-class group count), shuffle, seed=outer seed) fitted only on outer-training participants
calibration: Platt scaling fitted on DNE OOF scores only; TULIP labels never used
